propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline (e.g. G6, F1, E2) but nothing couples those citations to the criteria registry, allowing criterion text to change silently while guide paraphrases become stale.
A criterion-text change that contradicts a claim in a packaged prose guide must fail a gate with a report naming the criterion and the citing guide, forcing re-verification.

A gate must detect and report unknown citations (ids absent from registry), stale pins (cited criterion text changed), orphan pins (id no longer cited), and missing manifest, without breaking on ordinary prose edits that keep citations unchanged.

Citation extraction must depend only on the registry's closed criterion-id vocabulary matched at word boundaries, not on guide markup or structure, so prose rewording and restructuring do not falsely fail the gate.
